metadata.name: Standard Chess UNO
metadata.description: Standard 108-card Chess UNO game rules combining classic chess with UNO card effects.
metadata.author: TrackLord Team

PASS_TURN_EFFECT.description: Grants 0 moves; player turn ends immediately without chess actions.

MOVE_1.description: Grants up to 1 legal chess move.

MOVE_2.description: Grants up to 2 legal chess moves.

MOVE_3.description: Grants up to 3 legal chess moves.

MOVE_4.description: Grants up to 4 legal chess moves.

MOVE_5.description: Grants up to 5 legal chess moves.

MOVE_6.description: Grants up to 6 legal chess moves.

MOVE_7.description: Grants up to 7 legal chess moves.

MOVE_8.description: Grants up to 8 legal chess moves.

MOVE_9.description: Grants up to 9 legal chess moves.

SKIP_OPPONENT.description: Skips the opponent's next turn. Player retains initiative.

SWAP_OWN_PIECES.description: Swaps positions of two eligible friendly non-king pieces on the board.

REVIVE_UP_TO_TWO.description: Revives up to 2 captured friendly pieces onto eligible unoccupied squares in player's half.

REVIVE_UP_TO_FOUR.description: Revives up to 4 captured friendly pieces onto eligible unoccupied squares.

REVIVE_TWO_AND_MOVE_TWO.description: Revives up to 2 friendly pieces, followed by up to 2 chess moves.

WILD_CHOICE.description: Player chooses one ability from: Move 1 piece, Revive up to 2 pieces, or Swap 2 friendly pieces.

WILD_DRAW_FOUR.description: Player chooses between reviving up to 4 pieces or reviving 2 pieces + making 2 moves.
